violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed PIC reset tableware after eating with bare hands. Observed no hand washing
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO WASH HANDS BEFORE PLACING NEW TABLEWARE. PIC WASHED HANDS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed a pot and strainer being stored in the hand sinks
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC MOVED THE POT AND STRAINER FROM THE HAND SINKS. HAND SINKS ARE FOR HAND WASHING ONLY. KEEP OBJECTS OUT OF THE HAND SINK.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed a container of glass cleaner being stored on the prep table
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. PIC MOVED THE GLASS CLEANER TO THE CHEMICAL STORAGE.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Hand sink next to the stove was observed leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. REPAIR HAND SINK SO ALLOW FOR PROPER HAND WASHING.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed no paper towels at the hand sink by the cook line
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC PLACED A ROLL OF PAPER TOWELS AT THIS HAND SINK.

violations.title: Food Not from Private Home
violations.observation: The following food item(s) is prepared in a private home, an unapproved food source, is distributed or offered for sale to the public: 1) chocolate mousse
violations.corrective_action: Food prepared in a private home may NOT be used or offered for human consumption in a food establishment. PIC PUT CHOCOLATE MOUSSE IN THIS VEHICLE TO TAKE BACK HOME. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO PREPARE CHOCOLATE MOUSSE ON SITE. HOME PREPARED FOODS ARE NOT ALLOWED TO BE SOLD TO CUSTOMERS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) halloumi cheese was observed at 50f. Upon discussion with PIC, cheese was placed in the prep top 1.5 hours prior to the inspection; 2) roasted beet purée was observed at 44f.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED THE CHEESE TO A WORKING COOLER. PIC DISCARDED THE BEETS.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Raw shelled eggs were being stored above an open container of canned chickpeas
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE EGGS BELOW THE CHICKPEAS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Greek yogurt was observed at 45f-46f in the 3DR prep top cooler. Halloumi cheese was observed at 51f in the countertop glass display cooler
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE GREEK YOGURT AND THE CHEESE.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: Steak, lamb, and pork chops
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. EHS REVIEWED THE MENU WITH PIC TO IDENTIFY THE MENU ITEMS THAT NEED AN ASTERISK. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO ADD THE ASTERISKS TO THE APPROPRIATE MENU ITEMS AND ADD A DISCLOSURE STATEMENT AT THE BOTTOM OF THE MENU. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: A bag of onions was observed being stored directly on the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC MOVED THE ONIONS TO A NEARBY SHELF.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer pita bread plastic bags were observed reused for the storage of Raw meat and prepared food in the 3DR upright cooler and the 2DR upright cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCONTINUE AND DISCARD ALL PLASTIC PITA BREAD BAGS. REPLACE WITH REUSABLE, NSF APPROVED CONTAINERS.
